# cepotxyz

> Creative Motion Developer based in Semarang, Central Java, Indonesia. Services include motion graphic, video editing, and graphic design.

## Services

- Motion graphic for product launches, promotions, explainers, and brand stories. Packages start at IDR 60,000.
- Video editing from client-provided footage, including rough cut, sound design, voice optimization, and color grading. Packages start at IDR 50,000.
- Graphic design, including logo design, Instagram feed design, ID cards with lanyard design, and banners.
- Logo design: IDR 150,000.
- Instagram feed design: IDR 15,000 per slide.
- ID card design: IDR 15,000 per card.
- Banner design: IDR 100,000.

Prices and service details may change. Refer to the pricing page for the current public price list.
